Hi Alex — thanks for the quick heads up and the screenshot. Sorry for the trouble.

Short answer: forwarded calendar items can sometimes strip our ephemeral join token if the forwarding flow rewrites the organizer header. That causes the server to reject the join URL with a 404.

Immediate options for today’s 11:00 PT demo:
- I can send a temporary shortlink (https://rwd.ai/s/xxxxx) that bypasses the invite token and will work for anyone who has the link.
- Alternatively, we can re-issue the invite from a shared organizer account (demo-host@redwood.ai) so distribution forwards keep the token intact.

Which do you prefer? I can push a temp shortlink in 5 mins if that helps.

Ben Carter
